## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Test whether a bamboo-forest aerial duel reads through opposed body arcs, one sword-contact point, and distinct landing anchors inside a complex misty ravine scene, with the attachment used only for one adult lead's visible appearance.
subject: Two complete adult swordswomen in an aerial duel, with the supplied portrait guiding only the visible appearance of the lead.
setting: A multi-depth bamboo ravine above a mountain stream at misty dawn.
event: The two airborne opponents converge at one visible sword-contact point while descending toward different landing anchors.
visual_priorities: Two complete separated adult bodies with clearly opposed attack arcs
One unmistakable steel contact point and two distinct reachable landing anchors
Reference-guided lead appearance and photoreal bamboo depth
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic wuxia action photograph of two complete, unmistakably adult swordswomen suspended inside a misty bamboo ravine at dawn. The lead visibly follows the supplied portrait through long near-black wavy hair with a center part, a softly oval face, warm brown eyes, straight brows, and natural closed lips. Show a bamboo-forest aerial duel across three depth layers: foreground leaves, the fighters above a silver stream, and receding green trunks. The lead cuts downward from camera right while the rival rises from camera left; their full-body arcs oppose each other and their blades meet at one crisp, readable steel contact point. Below them, a mossed boulder is the lead's landing anchor and an arched root shelf is the rival's separate landing anchor. A fallen red paper umbrella turns in the stream. Prioritize anatomical completeness, separated silhouettes, exchange geometry, and spatially plausible descent. Use a 50 mm lateral view, pale dawn backlight, suspended mist droplets, restrained robe motion, sharp faces, and photoreal bamboo, water, steel, and cloth.
